# Versioning for web components

The Polaris web component library is versioned. Choose the release your app loads and control when your app moves to a new version. This reference documents Polaris 2.0.

For production, we recommend the stable channel, `polaris-2.js`. It always serves the newest stable release in Polaris 2, so bug fixes, accessibility improvements, and new components reach your app without a script-tag change. The channel is published with the first stable 2.x release, so it isn't available while Polaris 2 has only a release candidate.
